findings.title: Returned modelCalls/usage includes an unpersisted conservative reserve despite zero new complete entry.
findings.observation: No prior receipts: actual entries 0, returned modelCalls 1 / input78 / output512 / cost0.25; acknowledged modelCalls/input/output/cost remain0. With prior receipts: actual entries remain2, returned modelCalls3 / input258 / output519 / cost0.5; acknowledged remains2 / input155 / output7 / cost0.25. Repeat returned input grows to81 or261 total, without extra model entry.
findings.cause: reserveNow increments run.usage and adds in-memory RESERVED before await persist; failed seal never returns a receipt. Error cleanup/finalize cannot save the oversized state; finalize returns live conservative usage.
findings.acceptanceImpact: Explicitly permitted diagnostic distinction in proof contract. Accept observation fidelity; do not interpret returned modelCalls as actual gateway entries or persisted debits.

findings.title: Refusal is returned but its terminal state and duration are not durably acknowledged.
findings.observation: The acknowledged post-resume checkpoint retains NEEDS_USER_INPUT, clears pendingQuestion and stores the answer/user observation. Thus the whole prior checkpoint is not unchanged. All acknowledged budget fields, including activeDurationMs, stay at pre-refusal values. Repeated identical user resume re-enters counter and capacity refusal; acknowledged unsigned content is unchanged from after first resume, though new checkpoint metadata is issued.
findings.cause: Initial native resume CAS fits in remaining space. Receipt seal and final stop checkpoint do not fit. Repeat recognizes already-resolved answer and supplies a fresh live resume observation, making the request different.
findings.acceptanceImpact: No claim of durable terminal rejection, persisted refusal duration or an aggregate repeated-attempt budget debit. Only first refusal plus one repeat per case observed.

findings.title: Toy64 is a declared synthetic pair, not tokenizer/provider qualification.
findings.observation: Counter/model share ceil(canonical UTF8 bytes/64), including JSON quoting of text. Large receipt identity metadata are legal 512-character synthetic values. Checkpoint pressure is synthetic p-padding, not a large model request. Positive resumed request bytes4935/6537 and no-space4935/6531 fit normally; repeated no-space requests5166/6762 also fit.
